comment: His grading can feel somewhat unclear, and I found the lectures less engaging, though that may be due to the nature of the material rather than his teaching. He is very approachable and willing to help during office hours. If you put in a genuine effort, participate, and meet with him outside of class when needed, earning an A is very achievable.
don't take him.
The class sucks, but he made it a lot better. Final is open note. Grading is unclear/I still don't know what my grade is. He said that he doesn't give out bad grades. Great guy!

I truly hate I have to say this, but this class was extremely stressful for me. Which is weird, because I took him due to the high ratings for him, but he's a bit hard to work with. For example, he is barely available to meet outside of class and won't even answer emails sent weeks ago. He made the research paper incredibly difficult for me :(

This course is inherently not super interesting but Dr.Allarkia is great! He cracks a lotta jokes.
Helps you with everything in  office hours with you.There's a big research paper that's 40%  and a final exam but it's open note.He makes it easy though and gives TONS of extensions.He cares about attendance but ends class early pretty much every time

I'm not sure why some other ratings are contradictory to mine. Unclear grading criteria and took a month to return a short multiple choice test. Very dull lecturer but people take this class because it's “easy.” Do not recommend.

Luai is one of the kindest and best professors at UR. Lectures are slide-heavy but he does his best to incorporate some of his personal experiences to make them more interesting. Always willing to provide feedback and super accessible outside of class. Clear grading criteria. Understands what it is like to be a student and wants you to succeed!

Dr. Allarakia is a professor that rewards you for the work you put into the class. The lectures are fairly slide-heavy, but he does a good job counterbalancing this with his knowledge and friendly demeanor. Office hours are very friendly and productive, and he'll often walk you through assignments and give you useful help. Overall, would 100% take.

Dr. Allarakia is a professor who does his best with what is given to him. PLSC270 is an inherently incredibly boring class, but he does everything in his power to make corny jokes and not make the subject unbearable. I will say he can be quite elementary with his explanation, such as going through what mean is in excruciating detail. Very nice man.

Dr. Allarakia is an exceptional professor whose approachable and supportive teaching style makes 270 a highly rewarding easy/medium difficulty course. His extensive knowledge and dedication to student success are pretty evident, and his office hours are great. With consistent average effort and responsibility, you're going to be fine and get an A.

Dr. Allarakia is a great person and a great professor. He is incredibly lecture heavy, and they can sometimes be slow, but he really cares about each student and is so accessible outside of class it is impossible to fall behind. Lots of writing, but take him if you can.

Luai is great. Makes a challenging course fun and accessible. Very open to meeting with students, gives 2 extensions and 2 absences, and is clear on expectations for assignments. Main grade of the semester is a research paper, but deadlines are split up so you don't get overwhelmed. An awesome prof and really enjoys teaching. Would take again.
I took the methods class. It was hard but Dr. Allarakia was very willing to help.

Very kind professor, always available to help. Our class was frustrating and didnt talk much, but he tried to keep things engagging. For me the topics were interesting. I would take another class with him.
I actually to PLSC240. The class is easy, but pretty boring. It's all lectures and he speaks with a very monotone voice. 3/5

Enjoyed having Luai for FYS this past spring. Gives great feedback and always willing to meet with students - encouraged us to come to office hours. Not a tough grader, not many assignments to do, but a lengthy final paper assignment with multiple due dates, which can be tough. Generous with extensions. Hope to have him again, for sure recommend.

Easiest and best rpf ever. took his intro to comparitive politics class and you almost had to try to not get an A. One paper and one presentation with light reading. Easy grader and just wants people to succeed. Ignore these other ratings.

I had Allakaria for my FYS Democracy in Crisis this semester. Very lecture heavy class, and if you're not into political science do not take the course. I made this mistake. Overall, really nice guy and gives good feedback.

I took Democracy in Crisis as my FYS and I would definitely recommend it to freshmen. There's a lot of reading and a good amount of work towards the end of the semester, but Luai was a very fair grader and flexible with deadlines. He gives you 2 excused absences and 2 extensions no questions asked. He's super funny; I would take him again.
Learned a lot! lots of reading and writing but very interesting subject

This professor gives an absurd amount of difficult reading, each with a summary to complete for credit. He is well aware of the difficulty and does not care if you understand what you're reading. He is not very organized either. He does not post grades at all and you will be lost with how you are doing in the class. Overall not worth it for an FYS.
